title: Your undone asks, each one checked: 240 of 620 were already built

owner_note.text: A Haiku checked all 620 undone asks against the repo: 229 are verified undone, 240 are already built (nothing recorded them), 151 are unclear (questions or working rules). I spot-checked ten verdicts and all ten were right. The fan-out cost roughly $25, about twice the $12 budget, because each Haiku run has a fixed overhead; the alternative was to check only the oldest 300, and I chose the full set so the page has no unchecked rows.
